meta: A self-check before episode 300: how far have you come with AI? 5 self-scoring questions after nearly a hundred videos, 201-299.

muc.title: Before episode three hundred
muc.text: Just one step to go until episode three hundred. These five questions show how far you've come.

muc.title: Delegating, reading news
muc.text: One, you know which tasks to hand to an agent and how to brief it clearly. Two, you read AI news without panicking at sensational headlines.

muc.title: Writing letters, spotting traps
muc.text: Three, you have AI draft letters, applications or job ads while keeping your own voice. Four, you spot online scams before you click.

muc.title: A whole day with AI
muc.text: Five, you use AI for real tasks every day, while the final decisions are still yours.

muc.title: Score yourself, share one task
muc.text: Score yourself on the five questions, one point each, then post your score and one thing you asked AI today in the pinned comment.
